description: A donut chart showing users by device, with a hollow center and small gaps between slices.
overview: A `PieChart` whose `Pie` uses `innerRadius` to leave the middle empty and `paddingAngle` to space the slices. `chartData` holds one record per device with a `users` count. Pressing a slice shows a tooltip.
usage: Replace `chartData` with your records and keep `dataKey` and `nameKey` in step with your field names. Add one entry per slice to `chartConfig` with its label and color; the component takes no props.
